audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds: Gossip P2P data columns undergo full validation (signature, KZG, inclusion proofs, proposer verification) via validate_data_column_sidecar_for_gossip. RPC P2P data columns use a different trust model: they undergo KZG verification only when received separately, but their parent block (which references them via inclusion proof) must be signature-verified and exist in fork-choice before acceptance, providing transitive validation.
